description: This file is the documentation and package declaration for the 'restful' Go package, which provides tools for creating REST-style web services, including route handling, filters, content encoding, error handling, and resource management.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Sets the root path for a WebService.

methods.name: Consumes
methods.description: Defines MIME types that the WebService consumes.

methods.name: Produces
methods.description: Defines MIME types that the WebService produces.

methods.name: Route
methods.description: Adds a route to the WebService.

methods.name: PathParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a path parameter from the request.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Adds a filter to a WebService or Route.

methods.name: EnableContentEncoding
methods.description: Enables gzip and deflate content encoding for responses.

methods.name: TraceLogger
methods.description: Enables detailed request matching and filter invocation logging.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Overrides the default logger used by the package.

methods.name: SetCompressorProvider
methods.description: Sets the compressor provider for content encoding.
